You eat right away and recover that much health. With full health you don't eat, unless you are hungry with realistic life.

Con sí, a pie suena un toque al llegar a: With yes, on foot a tone plays when you reach a crossing and it says where you are; at the wheel it warns you of the coming crossing and which street it is with. With no, crossings are not announced.
Con sí, al llegar a la puerta de un luga: With yes, when you reach the door of a place it says which one it is and, if a mission starts there, that you can start it with Enter. With no, nothing is said when you arrive.

Con sí, el juego habla con la voz de Win: With yes, the game speaks with the Windows voice, which is adjusted just below. With no, your screen reader speaks, and if you don't have one open, the Windows voice. It applies right away.
Con sí, mientras sigues un destino marca: With yes, while you follow a destination set on the GPS, the game tells you when and which way to turn. With no, it says nothing along the way and only the beacon guides you, if you have it on.

Says what this place is like.

Choose one of the five slots to save the game as it is. You can't during a mission.

En esta localidad no se corre ninguna ca: No race is run in this town.
En este grupo no hay nada ahora mismo. P: There is nothing in this group right now. Try another group or All places.

En un servidor, cada vivienda es de un s: On a server, each home belongs to a single player. If its owner sells it, the price shows here.
Encarna te dice qué tienes que hacer aho: Encarna tells you what you have to do now or where you should drop by.

Intro lo hace sonar otra vez. Su volumen: Enter plays it again. Its volume is adjusted in Options, Sound and music, Adjust the volume of each sound.

La radio de los vehículos, el reproducto: The vehicle radio, the headphone player and the background music. A sample plays when you change it. Change it with the left and right arrows.
La versión que tienes instalada. Las ver: The version you have installed. New versions are checked for in Options, Updates.

Las mejoras que lleva este vehículo y su: The upgrades this vehicle has and its faults, if any. Enter reads it again.
Las misiones que puedes hacer ahora, con: The missions you can do now, with where each one starts. Enter sets the spot on the GPS.

Lo dejan al 100 por ciento. Cuanto más d: They leave it at 100 percent. The more damaged it is and the more it is worth, the more it costs.

Lo que hace este botón del mando. Los bo: What this gamepad button does. Buttons are reassigned in Options, Gamepad.
Lo que llevas encima para tomar o para v: What you carry to take or to sell, the effects you feel now and your dependence.
Lo que puedes pedir por teléfono: que te: What you can ask for by phone: having a vehicle brought from a garage, a driver, bodyguards, an ambulance, a taxi or roadside assistance.

What this business gives you every midnight, depending on how you collect it. It can go up or down depending on how you look after it.

Los sonidos de los menús, del dinero, de: The sounds of menus, money, messages and missions, and the beacons. A sample plays when you change it. Change it with the left and right arrows.

You ask the server for it: if you have the money and it is still for sale, the home becomes yours.

Todos los lugares de la localidad, por g: All the places in the town, by groups and with where each one is. Enter on one sets it on the GPS.
Tu nivel en cada habilidad, que sube al: Your level in each skill, which goes up as you practice it, and the achievements you have earned so far.
Tus armas con su munición, los botiquine: Your weapons with their ammo, the first aid kits, the lock picks, the armor and the backpack.
Tus cartas, lo que suman y la carta que: Your cards, what they add up to and the card the dealer is showing. Enter reads it again.
Tus casas, tus negocios con lo que dan a: Your houses, your businesses with what they give per day, your boats and what you have in the bank.
Un barrio o una localidad, y cómo es. Lo: A neighborhood or a town, and what it's like. The ones you haven't set foot in yet say unvisited.

Una tecla que has cambiado tú. Se cambia: A key you have changed yourself. It is changed or restored in Options, Keyboard: change the keys.
